mechanism.claim: During a high-variation completed Asia session, same-direction movement in Upbit KRW-BTC cash and Binance BTCUSDT perpetual is cash-sponsored regional price discovery when the absolute Upbit move exceeds the perpetual move. Follow the common direction for twelve hours as the larger Korean cash impulse transmits globally.
mechanism.side: common strict nonzero sign of completed Upbit and Binance returns
mechanism.why_distinct: KPAR used FX-adjusted kimchi-premium acceleration; DCVPRR used cross-venue participation rotation; SLVCR used Binance spot/perpetual partial transmission under implied-volatility expansion. KCLR uses direct Upbit-versus-perpetual price leadership, no FX, premium, volume, flow, or implied volatility, and promotes no prior control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed Binance session realized-variation rank must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one daily 08:05 UTC regional cash-leadership clock is distinct from the dense asymmetric fresh_kimchi_fx sleeve

features.session: exact aligned bars_upbit KRW-BTC and bars_binance BTCUSDT 1m paths [00:00,08:00) UTC each calendar day; all 480 timestamps required
features.returns: log(07:59 close/00:00 open) independently by venue; strict nonzero and same sign
features.leadership: abs(Upbit return)>abs(Binance perpetual return), strict inequality and no magnitude threshold
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared Binance 1m log(close/open)) over the completed session
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 270 previous valid daily sessions; minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.availability: 08:00 UTC after both exact source paths complete
features.missing_duplicate_nonpositive_or_incoher: ineligible or source failure; no imputation

clock.decision: each calendar day 08:00 UTC after both source sessions complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent Korean cash price-leadership channel plus user-required high volatility

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no session, leadership, threshold, side, hold, timing, volatility, or subset repair
